metadata.dcterms:title: On local solutions of the Ramanujan equation and their connection formulae
metadata.dcterms:creator: MORITA∗, Takeshi
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We show connection formulae of local solutions of the Ramanujan equation between the origin and the inﬁnity. These solutions are given by the Ramanujan function, the q-Airy function and the divergent basic hypergeometric series 2ϕ0(0, 0; −; q, x). We use two diﬀerent q- Borel-Laplace transformations to obtain our connection formulae.
